Click on Add-ons and then Get add-ons

Uninstall
Uninstall can be done by two methods
Uninstall directly from Google Workspace Marketplace
Uninstall from Docs/ Forms/ Sheets/ Slides
Option 1 - Uninstall directly from Google Workspace Marketplace
Browse to Google Workspace Marketplace.
Search for Jivrus.
All our add-on's will be displayed in a single page.
Select the add-on you need to uninstall.
Click on uninstall and follow the process.
Click Uninstall button
A confirmation popup appears to cancel or uninstall app.
Click Uninstall App to uninstall the add-on.
Option 2 - Uninstall from Docs/ Forms/ Sheets/ Slides
Open your Docs/ Sheets/ Forms/ Slides
Click on Add-ons and then Manage add-ons
A Google Workspace Marketplace page will open.
The add-ons that are installed will be displayed.
Select the add-on that needs to be uninstalled.
Select the add-on that needs to be uninstalled.
Click Uninstall button
A confirmation popup appears to cancel or uninstall app.
Click Uninstall App to uninstall the add-on.
By following the above steps you can uninstall the add-on.
FAQ
handled by Google Workspace and Google, not the add-on provider
Why I am not able to install an add-on?
If you are not able to install an add-on please check your admin network whether permissions are allowed and retry again to install.
Who to contact if I am not able to install an add-on?
If you are not able to install the add-on, please contact the Google Workspace or Google team for help.
Why I am not able to uninstall?
If you are not able to uninstall an add-on try to refresh the add-on once and try to uninstall, if the same problem continues again it might be an internal error in development.
Who to contact if I am not able to uninstall an add-on?
If you are not able to uninstall an add-on please contact the developer team immediately for help.
Why the add-on does not appear after installation?
If the add-on does't appear after installation, check whether the installation is done properly, if not follow the installation steps mentioned above and try to install again.
Why add-on menu does not appear for my add-on?
If menu does not appear in your add-on, try to refresh the add-on several times and again if the menu doesn't appear please contact the developer team.
